item.title: EdgeQ Technologies Private Limited: AI Data Quality Analyst
item.skills: Data Analysis, Data Visualization, Python, SQL, Machine Learning, Data Preprocessing, Numpy, Data Cleaning, Data Labeling, and Data Annotation
item.description:
Headquarters: United States

AI Data Quality Analyst

Job Title: AI Data Quality Analyst
Location: United States (Remote)
Work Mode: 100% Remote
Experience: 2–6 Years
Salary Range: $70,000 – $115,000 per year (USD)
Employment Type: Full-Time
Job Category: Artificial Intelligence / Data Analytics / Data Quality

Job Summary

We are seeking a detail-oriented and analytical AI Data Quality Analyst to join our growing AI and Data Engineering team in the United States. The ideal candidate will be responsible for evaluating, validating, cleaning, and maintaining datasets used in artificial intelligence and machine learning applications.

The candidate should have experience in data quality assessment, data validation, data annotation, SQL, Python, and AI/ML data workflows. This role involves ensuring data accuracy, consistency, completeness, and reliability to improve AI model performance.

This position offers a fully remote work opportunity for qualified candidates across the United States.

Key Responsibilities

  • Analyze, validate, and maintain datasets used for AI and machine learning applications.

  • Identify missing, duplicate, inconsistent, and inaccurate data.

  • Perform data cleaning, preprocessing, and quality checks.

URL: https://terac.com

What We're Researching

We're hiring offensive cybersecurity experts for a long-term paid project focused on AI evaluation. Our goal is to build and harden reinforcement learning environments that test the limits of frontier AI models. This work directly contributes to understanding and mitigating advanced security risks in emerging technologies.

How It Works

You will work remotely on an hourly basis to design and implement complex cybersecurity benchmarks. Your tasks will involve creating robust reinforcement learning environments tailored for offensive security scenarios. You will continuously harden these environments to ensure they provide rigorous evaluations for AI systems. The project requires ongoing collaboration and iterative development to keep pace with new vulnerabilities.

Who This Is For

We welcome offensive cybersecurity engineers, penetration testers, and security researchers with strong technical backgrounds. Ideal candidates have hands-on experience building secure environments or developing security benchmarks. Familiarity with reinforcement learning or AI evaluation frameworks is highly valued but not strictly required.

  • Harden existing benchmarks to withstand advanced AI interactions
